info.name: Gymora Complete Collection
info.description:
Complete Gymora Backend Integration Test Suite.

## Structure
- **00 - Authentication & Setup**: Login, Switch Gym, Token management
- **API Endpoints**: All 25 controllers, 133 endpoints
- **01 - CRUD Verification**: Full lifecycle tests
- **02 - Security & Isolation Boundaries**: Multi-tenant and Ownership tests
- **03 - Caching & Auditing**: Cache behavior tests
- **04 - Creative User Stories**: End-to-end business flows

## Prerequisites
1. Select **Development** environment
2. Run **00 - Authentication & Setup** first
3. Run **Switch Gym** requests

## Variables
- `{{baseUrl}}`: API base URL
- `{{user1_token}}`, `{{user2_token}}`, `{{superAdmin_token}}`: Auth tokens
- `{{gymId}}`: Active gym context
- `last<EntityName>Id`: Auto-captured entity IDs
